name: Chiplab
description: Chiplab is an MCP server that lets AI coding agents build, run, and test embedded firmware on a virtual copy of the real chip — no physical hardware required. It supports STM32 and Nordic nRF52 chips across bare-metal, Zephyr RTOS, FreeRTOS, Eclipse ThreadX, and Embassy-Rust, compiling against production toolchains and simulating peripherals and interrupt timing with the same accuracy as real silicon. Any MCP-compatible AI coding tool — including Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code — can connect directly, with no local toolchain installation required.
